text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 12, "unit": "feet", "kind": "length", "span": "A rectangular living room measures 12 feet by 10 feet"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 10, "unit": "feet", "kind": "length", "span": "12 feet by 10 feet"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 2, "unit": "feet", "kind": "length", "span": "leaves a border 2 feet wide all around it"}], "plan": [{"op": "mul", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "area of the whole room"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q3", "q3"], "out": "s2", "note": "the border takes 2 feet off each of the two opposite sides"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["q1", "s2"], "out": "s3", "note": "length of the carpet"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["q2", "s2"], "out": "s4", "note": "width of the carpet"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s3", "s4"], "out": "s5", "note": "area of the carpet"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s1", "s5"], "out": "s6", "note": "room area minus carpet area is the border"}], "target": {"kind": "area", "scope": "the area of the border around the carpet"}, "dismissed": []}
